description: This script determines whether a particular feature is enabled based on configuration files and environment variables. It checks the status of features like LSA by querying configuration files (/lib/rdk/getRFC.sh and others), environment variables, and the existence of specific files, then logs the process and returns a boolean indicator.

methods.name: ifeLogging
methods.description: Logs messages with a timestamp to the specified log file.

methods.name: isFeatureEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a given feature is enabled based on configuration files, environment variables, and file existence.
